classification: Closed arithmetic first-moment and finite-covolume subobligations for the original isotropic count; geometric identification remains open.
reviewed_mathematics: Borel--Harish-Chandra 9.4 applies to both the unitary group and nonreductive vector stabilizer.
Platonov--Rapinchuk 5.4 supplies finite rational line cusps for the arithmetic group.
Cleared hyperbolic projections give a finite-index congruence-unit image at the actual level.
The special-unitary determinant correction and finite index of real units are valid in dimension at least three.
Scalar multiples have identical real and arithmetic vector stabilizers and use the same Haar measures.
Product coarea gives scalar norm exponent N-1 and radial exponent 2f(N-1).
All vector orbits, including unrestricted multiples, sum to the stated partial ideal zeta series.
Anisotropic cases, compact quotient lifts, finite components and finite-adelic support are retained.
limits: No Lean compilation or kernel replay.
The original geometric mean must still be identified with the normalized arithmetic Haar mean.
The arithmetic model and signed boundary intersection limit remain unproved here.
